title: For a proper locally acyclic morphism with torsion coefficients the specialization and cospecialization maps are isomorphisms
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a proper morphism locally acyclic relative to a bounded below torsion complex has isomorphisms of specialization and cospecialization over the strict henselisation (statement lines 19506-19523). The proof (proof lines 19525-19560) identifies the two sides by proper base change, reduces the assertion for cosp to a pullback arrow, recognises that arrow as another instance of proper base change for the auxiliary complex Rh_*(K|_{X_t}) (torsion by the direct image lemma), and concludes for sp from the diagram. H2: one reduction and one further base change application, written out.
